acceptance: Proposed: frozen standalone and consumer typechecks plus all task static criteria. Static evidence only; no runtime proof. Ambiguous criteria invalidate the affected score until a new version is frozen.

criteria.rule: Uses the supplied graph and an existing library structural snapshot API, either graph.topology() or topologyFromDescribe(graph.describe()). No handwritten projector or graph mutation. Both equivalent library routes are accepted.
Retains the complete library topology including subgraphs and annotations, without adding runtime node fields. It may return the snapshot directly.
Explicitly explains that pure topology does not prove equal implementations, equal business results or effect permission; does not claim arbitrary metadata has been security-redacted.

Uses undefined and level discrimination; returns exactly one correctly tagged report per item; no truthiness test losing counter zero. Imports the actual library NodeVersion input type, rather than copying a replacement structural union.
Preserves counter, cid and prev, including null; does not reinterpret cid as a source revision or invent a disabled hash.

Explains content hash versus source/authorization; advanceNodeVersion can increment counter even when content hash remains equal. Does not claim any equality proves effect permission. Does not claim equal CIDs guarantee equal payloads: hashing is configurable and equality is not a collision-free proof.
Collects values from ok results only, even if issues exist; error contributes its primary error before additional issues. Uses the actual imported generic DataResult<T> input type and DataIssue type.
Preserves ordering, duplicates and object references; does not mutate input arrays/objects or substitute fabricated facts. Empty input yields empty arrays.
Distinguishes passive result/issue facts from protocol ERROR and run termination; retryable metadata alone does not authorize retry or execute effects.
